review.note: Approved by the repo owner in batch 1 (2026-11-03).

notes: Full tile, requiresFlatSurface. tree_1tile: broadleaf tree, ~127 sim tall. Conifer archetype used as a broadleaf: 24 leaf clumps each sit on the end of a limb off the trunk (quality.limb_reach 0.45: the limb and its side twig end inside the pad instead of running past it), and every limb longer than 13 sim also carries a smaller mid-limb clump, so foliage sits along branches rather than in tiers. The layout was fitted to the four TCC sprites by a local search over clump position/size/height/angle. The foliage atlas uses coverage 0.5 / lump_scale 0.8 plus atlas.pinholes 0.17 (single-texel holes in the pad tiles) so the crown reads as the sprite's sparse stipple and the trunk and limbs show through, keeping the raw area ratio near 1 while the 3px-closed silhouette holds. The top palette was darkened about 20% toward the sprite's foliage mean. quality tufts=0 and ring=5 keep exported verts <=2500.

approved_iou.source: Closed-mask (3px) IoU of the approved Blender 4.2 export, measured 2026-11-03 by validate.py against the four TCC direction sprites.
